title: Vancouver
content: Vancouver is a coastal city in British Columbia, Canada. It is known for mountains, ocean views, Stanley Park, and outdoor activities.

title: Banff
content: Banff is a mountain town in Alberta, Canada. It is popular for hiking, skiing, Lake Louise, and views of the Rocky Mountains.

title: Quebec City
content: Quebec City is a historic city in Quebec, Canada. It is known for Old Quebec, European-style architecture, and winter festivals.

title: Niagara Falls
content: Niagara Falls is a major waterfall destination in Ontario, Canada. Visitors can take boat tours and enjoy nearby attractions.

title: Toronto
content: Toronto is Canada's largest city. It is known for the CN Tower, museums, multicultural neighbourhoods, and Lake Ontario.
